title: Do you prefer watching concerts in person or online ?
text:
# Part 1
I prefer watching concerts in person /rather than online.
There are several reasons /to support my opinion.

# Part 2 
First of all,/ watching a concert in person /usually offers a much better atmosphere./ 

If I am actually at the venue,/ I can feel the energy of the crowd /and enjoy the live performance more deeply.

# Part 3 
Secondly,/ seeing my favorite idol in person/ is more exciting and memorable./Plus,/ going to a concert is a great social activity./ Sharing this unforgettable experience with my friends /and singing along with thousands of fans/ makes the event truly special.

# Part 4 
As a result,/ it helps me release stress /and recharge my batteries / in a way that watching a screen at home /cannot fully provide.

# Part 5 
That's why I prefer watching concerts in person.
